column1: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chicken and season with salt and pepper.
Cook 4–6 minutes, stirring now and then, until cooked through. Add the bell pepper and pineapple and cook 3–5 minutes until the pepper softens.
Whisk the pineapple juice, soy sauce, broth, hoisin, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, and cornstarch until smooth.
Pour the sauce into the skillet and simmer 1–2 minutes until thickened, then take off the heat.
Top with sesame seeds and green onions and serve.
